)

        data = json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8"))
    kl = (data.get("data") or {}).get("klines") or []
    print("rows:", len(kl))
    if kl:
        print("first:", kl[0])
        print("last:", kl[-1])
except Exception as e:

"}
